stem: A Lomotil prescription is reviewed in a Massachusetts pharmacy. Select all supported conclusions.

choices.text: The Massachusetts Schedule V five-refill and six-month limits apply.
Lomotil is an unrestricted Schedule VI drug.
Covered Schedule V dispensing is MassPAT-reportable.
The prescription may be refilled for one year.
The Schedule II 30-day validity rule controls every refill.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A Massachusetts Schedule V prescription may not be refilled more than five times or later than six months after the prescription was issued.
